reason: The pinned OSM source has no road-traffic-signal ground-truth features. The 44 crossing=traffic_signals ways are crossing attributes and cannot safely be interpreted as junction signal locations.
required_before_implementation: Acquire a governed source with explicit road traffic-signal locations, directions, and applicability.
Define a source-to-XODR signal placement contract and validate it separately from pedestrian-crossing semantics.
Do not use the 44 crossing-tagged ways as a surrogate for traffic-light placement.
